semantics.sourceRasterStream: issuedAction on image row t is the accepted command executed before I_t was captured; RESET marks the initial/no-movement observation.
semantics.liveRequest: I_t is captured first; request t carries feedback for the command issued after I_(t-1). Server uses that action only when accepted and completed, otherwise RESET.
semantics.exactPoseAudit: Each case is externally restored before repeat rendering. No actor action causes a fresh repeat, so causal live input is RESET.
semantics.historicalTrainer: frame_stop_feature_matrix_v2 encoded frame.issued_action verbatim and ignored accepted/completed flags.

liveAdaptationHistoryAudit.note: Historical spatial-v2 live-adaptation encoded the prior action string even for these rows; live inference maps rejected/incomplete feedback to RESET.

interpretation.direction: none for exact-pose fresh renders; RESET was the causally correct action
interpretation.separateDefect: Historical training encoded rejected prior actions instead of RESET for a bounded subset of live-adaptation observations.
interpretation.cnnMeaning: The CNN comparison is not rescued or invalidated by action timing on the exact-pose fresh renders; the frozen baseline remains stronger cross-family evidence than the R4-A CNN.
